name: assetpanda/roi-calculator
title: AP Roi Calculator
description: Interactive savings calculator (the legacy /roi-calculator/): accordion groups of number fields and 0-100% sliders, each group closing on a subtotal, beside a sticky Your Savings panel with three breakdown rows, a gradient yearly total, the daily cost of delay and a button. Port of live's `.bs-section--roi-calculator`; behaviour.js recomputes on input with live's formulas operation for operation (loss = assets x value x lost% x tracked%; ghost value = assets x value x tracked% x ghost% x remaining%; ghost cost = ghost value x (federal + state + property tax)% + .01 x ghost value x insurance; search = tracked% x days x hours_per_day x salary / work_hours_per_year; total = loss + ghost cost + search; daily = total / days_per_year), and formats every figure the way live does (two decimals, dropped when .00). Lays out by its own width (container queries), so it fits an 800px article column or a full-width band. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
